comment: SHA-256 of the install media the guests are built from, checked on 2026-11-05. The Windows 11 value equals the publisher's .sha256 file; the Ubuntu value equals Canonical's SHA256SUMS for 26.04.1; the Windows 10 value was computed locally because the publisher's figure is not available offline. The no-prompt Windows 11 image is the same media with the boot prompt removed, so its value was computed locally.
